import Mathlib

/-!
# A counterexample to Király's conjecture on orientations of nonideal clutters

MathDB 388087 ("Orientation of nonideal clutters", Egres Open; Király's conjecture as stated in
J. Pap, EGRES TR-2010-09, Conjecture 1.2, and Pap's PhD thesis, Conjecture 3.4.5):

  Let `C` be a clutter on a finite ground set `V` and `B` its blocker. Then `C` is nonideal
  if and only if there exist `p : C → V`, `q : B → V` with `p X ∈ X`, `q Y ∈ Y`, and
  `p X = q Y → |X ∩ Y| > 1`.

We exhibit an 11-element clutter (the eleven 3-sets of a cubic `(11,3,4)` Lehman matrix) which is
nonideal (`(1/3,…,1/3)` is a non-integral extreme point of its covering polyhedron) and admits no
such pair `(p, q)`.  Hence the conjecture (its "only if"/nonideal ⇒ orientation direction) is false.

Definitions follow the sources: a clutter is a family of pairwise incomparable sets; the blocker is
the family of inclusion-minimal transversals; the covering polyhedron is
`P(C) = {x ∈ ℝ^V : x ≥ 0, x(X) ≥ 1 ∀ X ∈ C}` and `C` is ideal iff `P(C)` is integral, i.e. every
extreme point (vertex) of `P(C)` is an integer vector.
-/

namespace KiralyClutter

open Finset

section Definitions

variable {V : Type} [DecidableEq V]

/-- A clutter: no member contains another. -/
def IsClutter (C : Finset (Finset V)) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ C, ∀ Y ∈ C, X ⊆ Y → X = Y

/-- `T` meets every member of `C`. -/
def IsTransversal (C : Finset (Finset V)) (T : Finset V) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ C, (X ∩ T).Nonempty

/-- The blocker `b(C)`: the inclusion-minimal transversals of `C`. -/
def blocker (C : Finset (Finset V)) : Set (Finset V) :=
  {T | IsTransversal C T ∧ ∀ T' : Finset V, T' ⊂ T → ¬ IsTransversal C T'}

/-- The covering polyhedron `P(C) = {x ≥ 0 : x(X) ≥ 1 for all X ∈ C}`. -/
def coveringPolyhedron (C : Finset (Finset V)) : Set (V → ℝ) :=
  {x | (∀ v, 0 ≤ x v) ∧ ∀ X ∈ C, (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ v ∈ X, x v}

/-- `C` is ideal: its covering polyhedron is integral (every vertex is an integer vector). -/
def IsIdeal (C : Finset (Finset V)) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (coveringPolyhedron C), ∀ v, ∃ z : ℤ, x v = z

/-- Existence of Király's functions `p : C → V`, `q : b(C) → V`. -/
def KiralyProperty (C : Finset (Finset V)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (p : C → V) (q : blocker C → V),
    (∀ X : C, p X ∈ X.1) ∧
    (∀ Y : blocker C, q Y ∈ Y.1) ∧
    ∀ (X : C) (Y : blocker C), p X = q Y → 1 < (X.1 ∩ Y.1).card

end Definitions

/-- Király's conjecture (MathDB 388087), literally: for every clutter on a finite ground set,
nonideal ⇔ the functions `p, q` exist. -/
def KiralyConjecture : Prop :=
  ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (C : Finset (Finset V)),
    IsClutter C → (¬ IsIdeal C ↔ KiralyProperty C)

/-! ## A kernel-checked case-split certificate -/

/-- Case tree: `node i c0 c1 c2` branches on the three possible values of `p` on edge `i`;
`leaf j` asserts that blocker member `j` has all of its elements "killed". -/
inductive CTree where
  | leaf (j : Nat)
  | node (i : Nat) (c0 c1 c2 : CTree)

/-- Under the partial assignment `a` (pairs `(edge, value)`), every entry `(v, is)` of `K[j]`
has some edge `i ∈ is` assigned the value `v`. -/
def deadB (K : List (List (Nat × List Nat))) (j : Nat) (a : List (Nat × Nat)) : Bool :=
  decide (j < K.length) && (K.getD j []).all (fun e => e.2.any (fun i => a.contains (i, e.1)))

def chk (D : List (List Nat)) (K : List (List (Nat × List Nat))) :
    CTree → List (Nat × Nat) → Bool
  | .leaf j, a => deadB K j a
  | .node i c0 c1 c2, a =>
    match D.getD i [] with
    | [d0, d1, d2] =>
      chk D K c0 ((i, d0) :: a) && chk D K c1 ((i, d1) :: a) && chk D K c2 ((i, d2) :: a)
    | _ => false

theorem chk_sound (D : List (List Nat)) (K : List (List (Nat × List Nat))) :
    ∀ (t : CTree) (a : List (Nat × Nat)), chk D K t a = true →
    ∀ b : Nat → Nat, (∀ e ∈ a, b e.1 = e.2) → (∀ i, D.getD i [] ≠ [] → b i ∈ D.getD i []) →
    ∃ j, j < K.length ∧ ∀ e ∈ K.getD j [], ∃ i ∈ e.2, b i = e.1 := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf j =>
    intro a h b ha _
    simp only [chk, deadB, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, List.all_eq_true,
      List.any_eq_true] at h
    obtain ⟨hj, hall⟩ := h
    refine ⟨j, hj, fun e he => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hc⟩ := hall e he
    refine ⟨i, hi, ha (i, e.1) ?_⟩
    simpa using hc
  | node i c0 c1 c2 ih0 ih1 ih2 =>
    intro a h b ha hD
    simp only [chk] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i d0 d1 d2 hDi
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, h2⟩ := h
      have hbi : b i ∈ [d0, d1, d2] := by
        rw [← hDi]; exact hD i (by rw [hDi]; simp)
      have ext : ∀ d, b i = d → ∀ e ∈ (i, d) :: a, b e.1 = e.2 := by
        intro d hd e he
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | he
        · exact hd
        · exact ha e he
      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hbi
      rcases hbi with hb | hb | hb
      · exact ih0 _ h0 b (ext _ hb) hD
      · exact ih1 _ h1 b (ext _ hb) hD
      · exact ih2 _ h2 b (ext _ hb) hD
    · exact absurd h (by simp)

/-- Edge `i` of the counterexample clutter. -/
def X' (i : Nat) : Finset (Fin 11) := XL.getD i ∅

/-- Blocker member `j` (for `j < 36`). -/
def Y' (j : Nat) : Finset (Fin 11) := YL.getD j ∅

/-- The counterexample clutter on ground set `Fin 11`. -/
def C11 : Finset (Finset (Fin 11)) := (Finset.range 11).image X'

theorem mem_C11 {X : Finset (Fin 11)} : X ∈ C11 ↔ ∃ i < 11, X' i = X := by
  simp [C11]

theorem C11_clutter : IsClutter C11 := by
  have h : ∀ i < 11, ∀ j < 11, X' i ⊆ X' j → X' i = X' j := by decide +kernel
  intro X hX Y hY hXY
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_C11.1 hX
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := mem_C11.1 hY
  exact h i hi j hj hXY

theorem transversal_Y : ∀ j < 36, ∀ i < 11, (X' i ∩ Y' j).Nonempty := by decide +kernel

theorem minimal_Y : ∀ j < 36, ∀ v ∈ Y' j, ∃ i < 11, Disjoint (X' i) ((Y' j).erase v) := by
  decide +kernel

theorem Y_mem_blocker {j : Nat} (hj : j < 36) : Y' j ∈ blocker C11 := by
  refine ⟨fun X hX => ?_, fun T hT htr => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_C11.1 hX
    exact transversal_Y j hj i hi
  · obtain ⟨v, hvY, hvT⟩ := Finset.exists_of_ssubset hT
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hdisj⟩ := minimal_Y j hj v hvY
    have hsub : T ⊆ (Y' j).erase v := fun x hx =>
      Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => hvT (h ▸ hx), hT.subset hx⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := htr (X' i) (mem_C11.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    rw [Finset.mem_inter] at hx
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx.1 (hsub hx.2)

theorem fact_dom : ∀ i < 11, ∀ x ∈ X' i, x.val ∈ DL.getD i [] := by decide +kernel

theorem fact_cover : ∀ j < 36, ∀ y ∈ Y' j, ∃ e ∈ KL.getD j [], e.1 = y.val := by decide +kernel

theorem fact_single :
    ∀ j < 36, ∀ e ∈ KL.getD j [], ∀ i ∈ e.2, i < 11 ∧ (X' i ∩ Y' j).card ≤ 1 := by
  decide +kernel

theorem DL_len : DL.length = 11 := rfl

theorem KL_len : KL.length = 36 := rfl

/-- The kernel evaluates the certificate tree. -/
theorem cert_ok : chk DL KL cert [] = true := by decide +kernel

/-- No Király functions exist for `C11`. -/
theorem not_kiraly : ¬ KiralyProperty C11 := by
  rintro ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq⟩
  let Xc : (i : Nat) → i < 11 → C11 := fun i hi => ⟨X' i, mem_C11.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩⟩
  let b : Nat → Nat := fun i => if hi : i < 11 then (p (Xc i hi)).val else 0
  have hdom : ∀ i, DL.getD i [] ≠ [] → b i ∈ DL.getD i [] := by
    intro i hne
    by_cases hi : i < 11
    · simp only [b, hi, dite_true]
      exact fact_dom i hi _ (hp (Xc i hi))
    · exact absurd (List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by rw [DL_len]; omega)) hne
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hdead⟩ := chk_sound DL KL cert [] cert_ok b (by simp) hdom
  rw [KL_len] at hj
  let Yc : blocker C11 := ⟨Y' j, Y_mem_blocker hj⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he, he1⟩ := fact_cover j hj _ (hq Yc)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hbi⟩ := hdead e he
  obtain ⟨hi11, hcard⟩ := fact_single j hj e he i hi
  have hbval : b i = (p (Xc i hi11)).val := by simp only [b, hi11, dite_true]
  have hpq' : p (Xc i hi11) = q Yc := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [← hbval, hbi, he1]
  have h1 := hpq (Xc i hi11) Yc hpq'
  have h2 : (Xc i hi11).1 ∩ Yc.1 = X' i ∩ Y' j := rfl
  rw [h2] at h1
  omega

/-- The point `x* = (1/3, …, 1/3)`. -/
noncomputable def xstar : Fin 11 → ℝ := fun _ => 1 / 3

theorem card_X : ∀ i < 11, (X' i).card = 3 := by decide +kernel

theorem tight {a b s t : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a + b = 1) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (h : a * s + b * t = 1) : s = 1 := by
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hb.le]

theorem xstar_mem : xstar ∈ coveringPolyhedron C11 := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => by norm_num [xstar], fun X hX => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_C11.1 hX
  simp only [xstar, Finset.sum_const, card_X i hi, nsmul_eq_mul]
  norm_num

/-- The edge incidence system `x(X) = 1` (all eleven edges) has the unique solution `x*`. -/
theorem eq_xstar {y : Fin 11 → ℝ} (hy : ∀ i < 11, ∑ v ∈ X' i, y v = 1) : y = xstar := by
  have e0 : y 1 + (y 7 + y 10) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 0 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 0 = ({1, 7, 10} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e1 : y 2 + (y 3 + y 8) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 1 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 1 = ({2, 3, 8} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e2 : y 2 + (y 3 + y 4) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 2 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 2 = ({2, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e3 : y 0 + (y 3 + y 4) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 3 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 3 = ({0, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e4 : y 0 + (y 1 + y 4) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 4 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 4 = ({0, 1, 4} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e5 : y 0 + (y 5 + y 6) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 5 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 5 = ({0, 5, 6} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e6 : y 5 + (y 6 + y 7) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 6 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 6 = ({5, 6, 7} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e7 : y 1 + (y 6 + y 7) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 7 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 7 = ({1, 6, 7} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e8 : y 2 + (y 8 + y 9) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 8 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 8 = ({2, 8, 9} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e9 : y 8 + (y 9 + y 10) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 9 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 9 = ({8, 9, 10} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  have e10 : y 5 + (y 9 + y 10) = 1 := by
    have h := hy 10 (by norm_num)
    rwa [show X' 10 = ({5, 9, 10} : Finset (Fin 11)) from rfl, Finset.sum_insert (by decide),
      Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  funext v
  fin_cases v <;> simp only [xstar, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue] <;> linarith

theorem xstar_extreme : xstar ∈ Set.extremePoints ℝ (coveringPolyhedron C11) := by
  rw [mem_extremePoints]
  refine ⟨xstar_mem, fun y hy z hz hseg => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, h⟩ := hseg
  have hpt : ∀ v, a * y v + b * z v = 1 / 3 := fun v => by
    have := congrFun h v
    simpa [xstar] using this
  have hsum : ∀ i < 11, a * (∑ v ∈ X' i, y v) + b * (∑ v ∈ X' i, z v) = 1 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [hpt, Finset.sum_const, card_X i hi, nsmul_eq_mul]
    norm_num
  have hy1 : ∀ i < 11, ∑ v ∈ X' i, y v = 1 := fun i hi =>
    tight ha hb hab (hy.2 _ (mem_C11.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)) (hz.2 _ (mem_C11.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩))
      (hsum i hi)
  have hz1 : ∀ i < 11, ∑ v ∈ X' i, z v = 1 := fun i hi =>
    tight hb ha (by linarith) (hz.2 _ (mem_C11.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩))
      (hy.2 _ (mem_C11.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)) (by linarith [hsum i hi])
  exact ⟨eq_xstar hy1, eq_xstar hz1⟩

theorem C11_not_ideal : ¬ IsIdeal C11 := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h xstar xstar_extreme 0
  have hz' : (z : ℝ) = 1 / 3 := by rw [← hz]; rfl
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < z := by rw [hz']; norm_num
  have h2 : (z : ℝ) < 1 := by rw [hz']; norm_num
  have h1' : 0 < z := by exact_mod_cast h1
  have h2' : z < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h2
  omega

/-! ## Main results -/

/-- `C11` is a nonideal clutter without Király functions. -/
theorem counterexample : IsClutter C11 ∧ ¬ IsIdeal C11 ∧ ¬ KiralyProperty C11 :=
  ⟨C11_clutter, C11_not_ideal, not_kiraly⟩

/-- **MathDB 388087 is answered in the negative**: Király's conjecture is false. -/
theorem kiraly_conjecture_false : ¬ KiralyConjecture := by
  intro h
  exact not_kiraly ((h (Fin 11) C11 C11_clutter).1 C11_not_ideal)

end KiralyClutter
